faqs.q: What is the maximum operating pressure of the Sun Hydraulics DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve?
faqs.a: The DRBOX is rated 5000 psi or 350 bar maximum operating pressure on every listed version. Maximum leakage is 2 in³/min. (30 cc/min).

faqs.q: What flow capacity does the DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve have?
faqs.a: The DRBOX is rated 7 gpm or 28 L/min in series 1, which screws into a T-21A cavity. A larger series carries more flow, so check the pressure drop at your flow on the performance curve before you choose it.

faqs.q: Which seal materials and body finishes does the Sun Hydraulics DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve come with?
faqs.a: Seal options on the DRBOX are N = Buna-N, V = Viton. Body options: /AP = Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH = Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel. The seal is chosen by a letter near the end of the model code, as in DRBOXFN, so state the fluid when you order.

faqs.q: Which cavity does the Sun Hydraulics DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve fit?
faqs.a: The DRBOX screws into the T-21A cavity for series 1, machined to Sun's drawing for that series. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly.

faqs.q: Which seal kit fits the Sun Hydraulics DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve?
faqs.a: Sun supplies a seal kit for every series of the DRBOX. Listed kits: series 1, Buna: 990021007, Polyurethane: 990021002, Viton: 990021006. Only the external seals are serviceable; fitting a different external seal does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid.

faqs.q: How is the Sun Hydraulics DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve installed?
faqs.a: Screw the DRBOX into its T-21A cavity and tighten to 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm) on a 7/8 in. (22,2 mm) hex. Do not over-torque, and keep the cavity clean and free of burrs.

faqs.q: Where is the Sun Hydraulics DRBOX direct-acting pressure-operated directional valve used?
faqs.a: The DRBOX is used for pressure-sequenced switching — unloading, high-low pump circuits, interlocks, piloting logic elements. Other cartridges for the same circuits are on the [check, shuttle & directional cartridges](/c/cartridge-check-shuttle-valves) shelf.

faqs.q: Sun Hydraulics DRBOX or DRBMX: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The DRBOX is the 3-way, drain to port 4 (1 blocked and 2 to 3 open) version, rated 7 gpm or 28 L/min, while the [DRBMX](/p/sun-hydraulics-drbmx-2-way-direct-acting-fixed-setting-directional-valve-drain-port-4-normally-open) is the 2-way, drain to port 4 and normally open version. Choose on the function you need, then check the other page for its flow and cavity before you swap one for the other.
